name: Rwag
summary: Rwag is the orc rogue trainer stationed in the Den, tucked within Durotar's Valley of Trials. He instructs newly arrived orcs and trolls in the arts of stealth, subterfuge, and dirty fighting under the watchful gaze of the Horde.

sections.title: Shadows of the Valley
sections.body: Operating deep within the cave known as the Den, Rwag trains fledgling rogues, cutpurses, and thieves before they step out into the wider world of Durotar. While the new Horde champions martial honor and battlefield valor, Rwag understands that subtlety, poisons, and a well-placed dagger remain invaluable tools for survival in an unforgiving desert. He keeps a sharp eye on Valley business and harbors deep suspicions regarding the dark practitioners also sheltering in the cave, particularly the warlock Nartok.

faq.answer: Rwag is an orc rogue trainer situated inside the Den in the Valley of Trials. He instructs novice orc and troll rogues as they begin their training in Durotar.
Rwag is located deep inside the Den, a cavern cut into the rocky cliffs of the Valley of Trials in Durotar, standing among several other class trainers.

faq.q: What does Rwag think of the warlocks in the Den?
faq.answer: Rwag openly distrusts the warlocks who share the Den, specifically keeping a cautious eye on the fel practitioner Nartok, noting that dark magic and secretive cultists require constant vigilance.

Rwag exclusively trains rogues, offering early martial instruction in abilities like Eviscerate and, at the Shattered Hand's request, keeping an eye on new recruits and passing along anything the Hand might need of them.

angles.text: For young orc and troll rogues stepping into the Valley of Trials, Rwag is the very first mentor in basic skulduggery, teaching early offensive techniques and deciphering secret ciphers.
Rwag represents the practical, unsanitized edge of orcish survival, proving that even in Thrall's honorable new Horde, shadows and cold steel remain vital.
